newsitem.title: USA: WFI Industries sees profit for full year.
newsitem.headline: WFI Industries sees profit for full year.

text.p: WFI Industries Inc said Thursday it was forecasting a profit for the full year, based on the expectation that sales during the remainder of 1996 would remain ahead of 1995 levels.
Earlier, the company reported third-quarter net income of $0.01 a share on sales of $8.8 million, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.06 on sales of $7.4 million.
For the first nine months of the year, WFI posted a loss of $0.04 a share on sales of $21.5 million, compared with a loss of $0.17 a share on sales of $20.4 million in the year-earlier period.

"The strong third-quarter results cap a successful first year under the new management team which was assembled to turn around WFI," James Cich, president, said in a statement. "Our team has achieved four consecutive quarters of improved financial performance versus the prior year."
WFI, which makes geothermal heating and cooling products, said new product introductions helped boost residential sales in the third quarter.

"During the quarter we entered into strategic distribution relationships that should further our leadership position within the industry," Cich said. "Key networks were augmented in Texas and Ohio, in particular. Commerical sales continued to build during the quarter, and this market is expected to show even more growth in 1997 once several new commercial products are introduced."
